decision_scope: Bounded full eyelid closure and supplied sequential blink evidence only
finite_promotion_recommendation: Accept R4f as a bounded functional eyelid-closure improvement with the listed art limitations retained. No additional corrective round is required for this bounded closure criterion; root/QA own promotion and broader acceptance.
summary: All three fully closed static views occlude the globe, including the medial corners where rejected R4e leaves white wedges. The full-closure sequential frame also has no visible white aperture. R4f removes the prior doubled overlay band and black patch perimeter. Puffiness, hooked/scalloped closed contours, and larger neutral eye openings retain a LIMITED face-art result.

actual_inclusive_sequential_range: /workspace/scratch/rama-native-face-render-r4f/blink-000.png through blink-029.png; all 30 frames opened individually in order

findings.criterion: Actual full closure, including medial corners
findings.observation: No visible white-globe aperture, iris or pupil at full closure in any reviewed angle. R4e front/three-quarter closed counterexamples visibly show white medial wedges; the corresponding R4f joins contain skin/dark closure crease. A dark crease remains but does not expose the globe.

The pupils remain paired at consistent height/direction with no visible divergent gaze or floating globe. Neutral openings are larger/rounder and expose more white than matched R3 baseline, which changes the face expression and remains an art limitation.

findings.criterion: Doubled horizontal overlay band and outer boundary seam
findings.observation: No R3-style separate horizontal overlay strip or conspicuous black polygonal outer patch line is visible. Native surrounding orbital skin appears continuous without a detached cutout perimeter in the supplied views.

findings.criterion: Corner joins and closed fold shape
findings.observation: Lids appear puffy during closure, with localized bright upper-lid bulges. The closure line forms a slightly scalloped/hooked contour at the inner corners rather than a polished natural arc; the profile has a heavy overhang. These visible sculpt/deformation limitations do not leave a white aperture at full closure and do not reproduce the prior overlay band.

Both eyes close and reopen together. Frames 003-005 close rapidly, 006 is the full closed pose, 007-013 reopen, and 014-029 settle/hold neutral. No detached boundary flash, unexpected asymmetric snap, broken isolated frame or discontinuous mesh split is visible. Small medial white areas return as the lid reopens in partial poses, not in the full-closure pose.
